Metadata.Title: RHSA-2026:62568: kernel security, bug fix, and enhancement update (Important)

Platforms: Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9.6 Extended Update Support

Metadata.Description:
The kernel packages contain the Linux kernel, the core of any Linux operating system.

Security Fix(es):

* kernel: Squashfs: sanity check symbolic link size (CVE-2024-46744)

* kernel: ksm: use range-walk function to jump over holes in scan_get_next_rmap_item (CVE-2025-68211)

* kernel: Bluetooth: SCO: fix race conditions in sco_sock_connect() (CVE-2026-43023)

* kernel: netfilter: nft_set_pipapo_avx2: don't return non-matching entry on expiry (CVE-2026-43114)

* kernel: net: ipv6: fix NOREF dst use in seg6 and rpl lwtunnels (CVE-2026-46099)

* kernel: Bluetooth: hci_event: fix potential UAF in SSP passkey handlers (CVE-2026-46056)

* kernel: RDMA/mana: Validate rx_hash_key_len (CVE-2026-46145)

* kernel: ipv6: fix possible UAF in icmpv6_rcv() (CVE-2026-53006)

* kernel: ipv4: free net->ipv4.sysctl_local_reserved_ports after unregister_net_sysctl_table() (CVE-2026-64002)

* kernel: crypto: qat - validate RSA CRT component lengths (CVE-2026-64304)

* kernel: net: bridge: stop fast-leave after deleting a port group (CVE-2026-74480)

* kernel: vhost: reset the vring metadata cache on vring reconfiguration (CVE-2026-74580)

Bug Fix(es) and Enhancement(s):

* [RHEL 9] Bonding reports unknown speed/duplex for tg3 interface  [rhel-9.6.z] (JIRA:RHEL-182767)

* [RHEL9] tlbflush - Windows Driver Verifier catches FLTMGR/Ntfs crashes during KVM 42-VM soak test on AMD EPYC Turin [rhel-9.6.z] (JIRA:RHEL-214435)

* vhost: reset the vring metadata cache on vring reconfiguration [rhel-9.6.z] (JIRA:RHEL-224548)

* [RHEL9] BUG: KASAN: global-out-of-bounds in scsi_sysfs_add_host+0x179/0x1b0  [rhel-9.6.z] (JIRA:RHEL-234440)

For more details about the security issue(s), including the impact, a CVSS score, acknowledgments, and other related information, refer to the CVE page(s) listed in the References section.
